precepts.text: In the last days the mountain of the Lord's house shall be established in the top of the mountains and exalted above the hills, and all nations shall flow unto it, for out of Zion shall go forth the law. The munitions of rocks.
precepts.point: Jeremiah 46:27: fear not, O my servant Jacob, because Jacob's trouble and Armageddon are coming; I will save thee from afar off, this far-off land, and thy seed from the land of their captivity, and Jacob shall return and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

note.label: Hope Amid Destruction

precepts.why:
Isaiah 33:16 says the one who walks righteously “shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks”. His place of defence is the kingdom, and Isaiah 2 shows what the munitions of rocks are.

“And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills”. The mountain of the Lord's house is the highest government on earth, literally. “and all nations shall flow unto it.”

“And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law”. That is what goes forth out of Zion: the law.

So to dwell on high is to dwell in that kingdom, set above every other government, and that is the promise to the one who meets the stipulation of Isaiah 33:15. There, “bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.”

precepts.text: Enter into the rock and hide thee in the dust for fear of the LORD; caves are made out of rock, and the day of the LORD is upon everyone that is proud and lofty.
precepts.point: They hid in caves, and that is what the nations are going to do again. What we read in Joshua is future prophecy: in the day of the Most High men shall go into the holes of the rocks and into the caves of the earth for fear of the LORD, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

note.label: Joshua 10: The Day the Sun Stood Still

precepts.why:
The five kings hid in a cave, and that is what the nations are going to do again. “Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty.” Caves are made out of rock. What we read in Joshua is future prophecy.

“The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day. For the day of the Lord of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low”. The day of the Lord is upon everyone that is proud and lofty, and they shall be brought low, as those kings were brought out of the cave with the feet of the captains of Israel upon their necks.

precepts.text: They shall go into the holes of the rocks and into the caves of the earth for fear of the LORD, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth; a future prophecy.
precepts.point: They hid in caves, and that is what the nations are going to do again. What we read in Joshua is future prophecy: in the day of the Most High men shall go into the holes of the rocks and into the caves of the earth for fear of the LORD, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

note.label: Joshua 10: The Day the Sun Stood Still

precepts.why:
“And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.” In the day of the Most High men shall go into the caves of the earth for fear of the Lord, just as the five kings hid in the cave at Makkedah. A future prophecy.

“In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats; To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.” That is why Joshua said, “Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.” What he did to those five kings he shall do to all the enemies of Israel when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

precepts.text: He shall judge among the nations and they shall beat their swords into plowshares; nation shall not lift up sword against nation.
precepts.point: Right now the Most High has not stopped the wars, so this is a prophecy not yet come. We are in the midst of wars and rumors of wars, the beginning of sorrows.

note.label: Psalm 46: God Is Our Refuge and Maketh Wars to Cease

precepts.why:
“he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.” Isaiah says the same as Micah: “he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.”

Two prophets, one word: wars cease when the Most High judges among the nations. Right now he has not stopped the wars, so this is a prophecy not yet come; we are in the beginning of sorrows. But it is coming, and the God of Jacob is our refuge until it does.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 20

precepts.why: “The mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains”: the kingdom will be literally at the top of the highest mountain. You will always look up to Jerusalem; that is literal and spiritual. We will be the top of all governments on the earth. “For out of Zion shall go forth the law”: the law is what will be taught throughout the earth. The law is the true religion; it always has been and always will be.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 6 The 4 Horsemen

precepts.why: John got this from Isaiah. Isaiah saw a lot of stuff; it is a surprise he didn't lose his mind, because everything John saw in Revelation you read in Isaiah. The satellites, the technology are going to be completely destroyed; no power at all. “and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.” Only God will be exalted in that day. They cannot stop him.

precepts.why:
“And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth,” That is the bunkers in the video. “for fear of the Lord,” Running from God; that is what it is saying. “and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.” When he allows those bombs to drop; when he shows up here and shakes the earth himself.

“In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;” Now all of a sudden they are going to try to run to their gods to save them, and they ain't going to save them. Are they going to be eating bats, getting the coronavirus, whatever the hell virus it is? That day, when they get out from underneath the bunker, they are going to see the pure black man: oh, what happened to black people, why didn't they get burnt? No, no: they're coming for you. Knock on the mountain door.

“To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.”

Watch this verse 22. “Cease ye from man,” Don't rely on the white man to save you. Cease ye from man. “whose breath is in his nostrils:” Who can die just like you. “for wherein is he to be accounted of?” Because he is gone; he will be dead along with you, for relying on him.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches

Here is the conflict. “I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.” Parted my land: Greg Laurie, we just told you who it is parted between. precepts.why: The great and high mountain. “The mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains”: you’re going to have to look up to the kingdom of the Lord.
